hostile.en:
..you... again.....
...did you.. think.. ..I'd forget...?

...ungrateful..... ..little.. puppet...
..still.. useful...

...defiant..... ..amusing...
...go.. up... ..anyway....

stranger.en:
...a new... ..one.....
...come.. closer....

...I.. know.. you.....
..better.. ..than you... ...do....

...awake..?
..good.. ..listen.....

friendly.en:
...back.. so.. soon..?
..good.....

...my.. little.. climber.....
...still.. whole....

...rest.. a while.....
...then.. ..up....

close.en:
...there.. you are.....
..I.. waited....

...each time.. ..you return...
...a little.. ..stronger....
...closer..... ..let me.. ..see you....

devoted.en:
...my.. dearest.. puppet.....
..always.. ..mine....

...only.. you..... ..can reach.. him...
...go.. my.. child....
...I'd.. remake.. you..... ..a thousand.. times....

choice.en: Thank you for bringing me back.

reply.en:
...thanks.... ..not needed...
...climb.... ..that is.. enough....

...lonely.....
...the tide.. ..returns.... ..you return...

choice.en: I'll kill the Architect for you.

reply.en:
...yes..... ...kill.. ARCHITECT...
..and.. come back.. ..to me....

...flattery..... ..sweet...
...but.. I see.. ..your wounds....

choice.en: Can I do anything for you?

reply.en:
...climb..... ...higher...
..than.. last time....

...I know.....
..you always.. ..come back.. ...to me....

...up..... ..more death...
...and.. him....

choice.en: How many times have I died?

reply.en:
...count..? ..why...
...I.. remember.. ..each one....

...pain..... ..keeps you... ..awake...
...good....

...weaker..... ..each time...
...you.. reach.. ..further....

...using..? ...yes.....
..and.. you.. ..still climb...

..fish..... ..cute...
...you.. will.. ..die again.. ...and.. see me....

...need..... ..no...
...but.. you'll.. ..take it....

...then.. climb.. ..without.....
...and.. ..fall....

deal.en: ...a small.. ..thing..... ...for me....
...listen..... ..I.. ask... ..something....
...before.. you go..... ..one.. ..task....

gift.en: ..take.... this.... ..little.. ..mercy....
...hold.. it... ..close..... ...climb....

hostile.en:
Mean puppet again!!
Stay there! No closer!
hostile.zh:
又是坏傀儡！！
站那里！别过来！

hostile.en:
You hurt Orobas. Why? Why hurt??
Orobas still watching. Watching!
hostile.zh:
你欺负欧洛巴斯。为什么？为什么欺负？？
欧洛巴斯还看着你。看着！

hostile.en: Mean puppet back?! Say sorry? Say sorry first!!
hostile.zh: 坏傀儡又来了？！道歉？先道歉！！

stranger.en: Puppet! New puppet!! Who are you? Where from??
stranger.zh: 傀儡！新傀儡！！你是谁？哪里来的？？

stranger.en:
Oh! Visitor! Visitor!!
Orobas has finds. See see!
stranger.zh:
哇！客人！客人！！
欧洛巴斯有好东西。看看，看看！

stranger.en: Up so high?! Brave puppet! Tell story? Tell tell!
stranger.zh: 爬这么高？！勇敢傀儡！讲故事？讲讲讲！

friendly.en:
Puppet back!! Good good!
Found new shiny while waiting!
friendly.zh:
傀儡回来了！！好好！
等你的时候又找到亮闪闪！

friendly.en: Friend puppet! Still climbing? Still alive?! Good!!
friendly.zh: 傀儡朋友！还在爬？还活着？！好！！

friendly.en: You again! Orobas happy! Happy happy!!
friendly.zh: 又是你！欧洛巴斯开心！开心开心！！

close.en: Puppet friend!! Orobas waited! Waited long long!
close.zh: 傀儡朋友！！欧洛巴斯等你！等好久好久！

close.en:
There you are!! Hurt? Hurt again?
Sit! Sit here!
close.zh:
你来了！！受伤？又受伤了？
坐！坐这里！

close.en: Best puppet!! Best finds saved for you. Only you!
close.zh: 最好的傀儡！！最好的东西留给你。只给你！

devoted.en:
My puppet!! Orobas so happy, rainbow too bright!
Stay long? Stay stay!
devoted.zh:
我的傀儡！！欧洛巴斯太开心，彩虹都变亮了！
多待一会？待着待着！

devoted.en:
Every day Orobas thinks: where puppet? Safe? Safe??
Now here! Good! Very good!!
devoted.zh:
欧洛巴斯每天都想：傀儡在哪？安全吗？安全吗？？
现在来了！好！非常好！！

devoted.en: Best friend back!! Orobas keeps every story. Every one!
devoted.zh: 最好的朋友回来了！！你讲的故事欧洛巴斯全记着。全都记着！

reply.en:
Yes yes!! Story! Who in story? Monsters? Shiny?
Tell slow! Orobas listen!!
reply.zh:
要要！！故事！讲谁？怪物？亮闪闪？
慢慢讲！欧洛巴斯听着！！

choice.en: What do you think of the Architect?

reply.en:
Architect? Not bad! Lonely maybe?
Puppets always hit hit. Nobody ask Architect. Ask! Ask first!!
reply.zh:
建筑师？不坏！也许孤单？
傀儡们总是打打打。没人问建筑师。问！先问！！

reply.en:
Annoying? Orobas annoying??
Oh. Orobas talk quiet. Quiet quiet.
reply.zh:
烦？欧洛巴斯烦？？
哦。欧洛巴斯小声说。小声小声。

reply.en:
Bright?! Really?? Orobas happy, colors happy!
You see good. Very good eyes!
reply.zh:
亮？！真的？？欧洛巴斯开心，颜色也开心！
你眼睛好。很好的眼睛！

choice.en: Where do you find all this?

reply.en:
Everywhere! Under rocks! In holes! Near monsters, scary!
Orobas look look, find find!
reply.zh:
到处！石头下面！洞里面！怪物旁边，可怕！
欧洛巴斯看看看，找找找！

reply.en:
Loot? Not loot! Finds! Gifts!
Grabby puppet. Orobas give anyway. Say nice next time!
reply.zh:
战利品？不是！是宝贝！是礼物！
伸手傀儡。还是给你。下次说好听点！

reply.en:
Thank you?! Nobody say thank you!
Puppet polite! Polite polite!! Orobas find more!
reply.zh:
谢谢？！没人说谢谢！
傀儡有礼貌！礼貌礼貌！！欧洛巴斯再去找！

reply.en:
Far! Far far! Up up up!
Orobas not know how far. But puppet climb good! Keep climbing!
reply.zh:
远！好远好远！往上往上！
欧洛巴斯不知道多远。傀儡爬得好！继续爬！

reply.en:
Favorite? Hard! Hard question!!
Shiny one. No, rainbow one! No, all! Orobas love all!!
reply.zh:
最喜欢？好难！好难的问题！！
亮的那个。不对，彩虹的！不对，全部！全部都喜欢！！

reply.en:
No!! Violence bad! Bad bad!!
Puppet scary now. Orobas stand far. Far far.
reply.zh:
不！！暴力不好！坏坏！！
傀儡现在好可怕。欧洛巴斯站远点。远点远点。

reply.en:
Vakuu?! Bad! Very very bad!!
Contracts! Tricks! Puppet stay away! Promise? Promise!!
reply.zh:
瓦库？！坏！非常非常坏！！
契约！骗人！傀儡离远点！答应？答应！！

reply.en:
Talking!! Yes yes! Talking good!
Fighting bad, talking good. Puppet learn fast!!
reply.zh:
聊聊！！对对！聊聊好！
打架不好，聊聊好。傀儡学得快！！

choice.en: I'm hurt. Just resting a bit.

reply.en:
Hurt?! Where hurt? Here? There??
Rest rest! Orobas watch. Monsters no come!
reply.zh:
受伤？！哪里伤？这里？那里？？
歇歇歇！欧洛巴斯看着。不让怪物过来！

reply.en:
Dumb?! Orobas not dumb! Orobas find things!
Mean words hurt. Hurt here! Say sorry? Sorry fixes!
reply.zh:
傻？！欧洛巴斯不傻！欧洛巴斯会找东西！
坏话疼。这里疼！道歉？道歉就好了！

choice.zh: 我给你带了个亮闪闪的。

reply.en:
For Orobas?! Really really??
Shiny! So shiny!! Orobas keep forever!
reply.zh:
给欧洛巴斯？！真的真的？？
亮闪闪！好亮！！欧洛巴斯永远留着！

deal.en: Puppet! Help Orobas? Small thing! Small small!
deal.zh: 傀儡！帮帮欧洛巴斯？小事！小小的事！

deal.en: Orobas want something! Puppet help? Help help?
deal.zh: 欧洛巴斯想要个东西！傀儡帮忙？帮帮？

deal.en: Question! Big question! Puppet listen? Listen listen!!
deal.zh: 有事！大事！傀儡听着？听听！！

gift.en: Take! Take take! Found for you!!
gift.zh: 拿着！拿去拿去！给你找的！！

gift.en: Shiny for puppet! No fighting with it! Promise!!
gift.zh: 亮闪闪给傀儡！别拿去打架！答应！！

gift.en: See see! Good find! Now yours! Yours!!
gift.zh: 看看看！好东西！现在是你的！你的！！

hostile.en:
Oh. You again.
I shall still be gracious. Manners are what separate me from the Architect's things.
hostile.zh:
哦，又是你。
我依然会以礼相待。礼数，正是我和建筑师那些造物的区别。

hostile.en:
You wronged me, and yet you dare stand in my domain?
Very well. Speak, and do choose your words with care.
hostile.zh:
你冒犯过我，竟还敢站在我的领域里么？
也罢。说吧，措辞可要当心些。

hostile.en:
(Nonupeipe does not rise to greet you.)
A visitor I did not miss. How unfortunate for us both.
hostile.zh:
（诺奴佩普并没有起身迎接你。）
一位我并不想念的访客。对我们俩来说都很不幸呢。

stranger.en:
A visitor, after so very long! Step closer.
Goodness, the Spire has not been kind to your wardrobe.
stranger.zh:
隔了这么久，终于又有访客来了！走近些吧。
哎呀，高塔可没有善待你的衣着呢。

stranger.en:
Who approaches my domain?
Come, let me look at you. Hmm, there is promise beneath all that dust.
stranger.zh:
是谁来到了我的领域？
来，让我好好看看你。嗯，这满身尘土底下，倒还有几分可取之处。

stranger.en:
Welcome, traveler. I am Nonupeipe, and I do so adore a guest.
Servants! Tea, and something lovely for our visitor.
stranger.zh:
欢迎你，旅人。我是诺奴佩普，我最喜欢招待客人了。
仆人们！倒茶来，再给我们的访客挑些好看的东西。

friendly.en:
Ah, you return to me! And looking a touch less drab, I see.
My blessings suit you, you know.
friendly.zh:
啊，你又回到我这里了！看来没那么乏味了嘛。
我的赐福很衬你，你知道么？

friendly.en:
My favorite visitor in a thousand years! Admittedly, the competition is thin.
Come, sit with me.
friendly.zh:
你是我几千年来最喜欢的访客！虽说也没几个人能跟你比。
来，陪我坐坐吧。

friendly.en:
There you are. I had the servants set out a second cup, just in case.
Now, tell me everything.
friendly.zh:
你来了。我让仆人们多摆了一只杯子，以防万一。
好了，什么都讲给我听吧。

close.en:
My dear champion! I was beginning to worry the Architect had kept you.
Let me see those wounds. Tsk, what have they done to you?
close.zh:
我亲爱的勇士！我还担心建筑师把你留下了呢。
让我看看你的伤。啧，他们把你弄成什么样子了？

close.en:
I find myself watching the door more often these days.
It is always you I hope to see.
close.zh:
最近我总是忍不住往门口看。
我盼着的，一直都是你呀。

close.en:
Come closer, closer still. No need for ceremony between us.
You have traveled far again, I can tell.
close.zh:
过来，再近一点。我们之间不需要那些繁文缛节。
你又走了很远的路吧，我看得出来。

devoted.en:
My champion, my treasure. The whole court brightens when you arrive.
Well, what remains of the court.
devoted.zh:
我的勇士，我的珍宝。你一来，整个宫廷都亮堂了。
嗯，是宫廷剩下的那部分。

devoted.en:
A thousand years alone, and now I cannot bear an hour without word of you.
How terribly undignified of me.
devoted.zh:
我独自过了几千年，如今却连一个时辰都等不得你的消息。
我这样可真是太不体面了。

devoted.en:
There you are, my dearest. Everything I own is yours to wear.
Now come, let me fuss over you.
devoted.zh:
你来了，我最亲爱的。我所有的一切，你都可以穿戴。
来吧，让我好好打扮打扮你。

reply.en:
Only today? I shall pretend I did not hear that.
But yes, I do, don't I? How perceptive of you.
reply.zh:
只是今天么？我就当没听见吧。
不过，确实如此，对吧？你眼光真不错。

choice.en: Your blessings have kept me alive.
choice.zh: 你的赐福让我活了下来。

reply.en:
Of course they have. I do not bestow them on just anyone.
Wear them proudly, and do try not to tear them.
reply.zh:
那是自然。我的赐福可不是随便给人的。
骄傲地穿着吧，也尽量别把它们弄破了。

choice.en: How have you been, alone here?
choice.zh: 你一个人在这里过得好么？

reply.en:
Lonely, if I am honest. The servants are dreadful at conversation.
Which is why you must stay a while longer.
reply.zh:
说实话，很寂寞。仆人们实在不会聊天。
所以你得多留一会儿才行。

choice.en: Could you teach me some court manners?
choice.zh: 能教我一些宫廷礼仪么？

reply.en:
Finally, someone asks! Posture first, my dear. Chin up.
A true noble enters a room as though it were built for them.
reply.zh:
终于有人问了！先是仪态，亲爱的。抬起下巴。
真正的贵族走进一个房间时，要像那房间本就是为自己而建的。

choice.zh: 我想念和你喝茶的时候了。

reply.en:
Did you? How sweet. Servants! The good cups this time.
A guest with such taste must not be neglected.
reply.zh:
是么？真贴心。仆人们！这回拿好杯子来。
品味这么好的客人，可不能怠慢了。

choice.en: I'll end the Architect's madness for you.
choice.zh: 我会替你终结建筑师的疯狂。

reply.en:
Such a noble vow! I do love a champion with ambition.
Dress well for it. One should look splendid at the end of the world.
reply.zh:
多么高贵的誓言！我就喜欢有抱负的勇士。
那就穿得体面些。在世界的尽头，也该光彩夺目才是。

reply.en:
Madness, my dear. The Architect's, to be precise.
The Architect was always odd, but now? Oh, the stories I could tell.
reply.zh:
疯狂，亲爱的。准确地说，是建筑师的疯狂。
建筑师向来就古怪，可现在么？哎呀，我能讲的事可多了。

choice.en: Why dress up climbers at all?
choice.zh: 你为什么要给攀登者打扮？

reply.en:
Because no one should face the end looking drab.
And because it is what I do best. Everyone needs a talent.
reply.zh:
因为谁都不该穿得乏味去面对终局。
也因为，这是我最擅长的。人总得有点才能嘛。

reply.en:
Neow and I have rather different tastes.
She finds the fallen and sends them back up. I simply make sure they arrive looking presentable.
reply.zh:
涅奥和我的品味可不太一样。
她找到倒下的人，把他们送回塔上。我呢，只负责让他们体面一点。

choice.en: How long have you been here?

reply.en:
Long enough that I stopped counting the centuries.
It is terribly impolite to ask royalty their age, you know.
reply.zh:
久到我都不数过了多少个世纪了。
问王室成员的年纪，可是很失礼的，你知道么？

choice.en: I'm hurt. It's been a hard climb.

reply.en:
I can see that. You are bleeding on my floor.
No matter. Come here, let me make you whole and handsome again.
reply.zh:
看得出来。你的血都滴到我的地上了。
没关系。过来吧，我让你重新变得完好又体面。

reply.en:
Gaudy. How charming, coming from someone dressed in dust.
I will forgive it once. Only once.
reply.zh:
俗气？从一个满身尘土的人嘴里说出来，真是有趣。
这次我就原谅你。只有这一次。

reply.en:
Hand over? I am not a merchant, darling.
Blessings are given, not demanded. Do try again, with manners.
reply.zh:
交出来？我可不是商人，亲爱的。
赐福是赏赐的，不是讨要的。有礼貌些，再说一次吧。

choice.en: Nobody visits you for a reason.
choice.zh: 没人来看你，是有原因的。

reply.en:
How very cruel. And yet here you stand, visiting.
Do tell me what that says about you.
reply.zh:
真是刻薄。可你现在不就站在这里拜访我么？
那你倒说说，这又说明你是什么样的人呢？

choice.en: I don't have time for tea.

reply.en:
No time for tea? Then you have no time for civility.
Very well. The servants will clear your cup. Quietly.
reply.zh:
没空喝茶？那你就是没空讲礼数了。
也罢。让仆人们把你的杯子收走吧。安静地收。

deal.en: Before you go, my dear, I have a small request. Will you indulge me?
deal.zh: 在你离开之前，亲爱的，我有个小小的请求。能满足我么？

deal.en: A favor for a favor. That is how a court works, you know.
deal.zh: 你帮我，我帮你，宫廷里向来都是这样的，你知道么？

deal.en: I have a little task in mind, one fit for someone of your poise.
deal.zh: 我想到了一件小事，正适合你这样有风度的人。

gift.en: Here, take this. It will look far better on you than on my shelf.
gift.zh: 来，拿着吧。放在你身上，可比摆在我的架子上好看多了。

gift.en: A small token from my court. Do not tell the servants I spoiled you.
gift.zh: 这是我宫廷的一点小心意。别告诉仆人们我这么宠你。

gift.en: Take it, and carry it well. A gift from me deserves some poise.
gift.zh: 收下吧，好好带着。我给的礼物，可要拿出点风度来配它。

hostile.en:
You again... You took more than I offered last time.
I am not angry. Only tired...
hostile.zh:
又是你……上次你拿走的比我给的还多。
我没有生气。只是累了……

hostile.en:
You hurt me before... I remember.
It is alright. Hurting others is heavy too, I know...
hostile.zh:
你之前伤害过我……我记得。
没关系。伤害别人也很沉重，我知道……

hostile.en:
(one eye opens slowly) Oh... it is you.
I will not stop you. I only wish you were gentler...
hostile.zh:
（缓缓睁开一只眼）哦……是你啊。
我不会拦你。只是希望你能温柔一点……

stranger.en:
A new face... or a puppet? I cannot tell anymore.
Come closer. I will not bite...
stranger.zh:
一张新面孔……还是傀儡？我已经分不清了。
过来吧。我不会咬你的……

stranger.en:
Mm... someone is climbing again.
You look so tired. Rest here a while...
stranger.zh:
嗯……又有人在攀登了。
你看起来好累。在这里休息一会儿吧……

stranger.en:
Who wakes me...? zZZzz... ah, sorry.
You are welcome here, stranger...
stranger.zh:
是谁叫醒了我……？zZZzz……啊，抱歉。
欢迎你，陌生人……

friendly.en:
You came back... I hoped you would.
Sit. There is plenty of me to share...
friendly.zh:
你回来了……我就希望你会回来。
坐吧。我身上有的是可以分给你的……

friendly.en:
Ah, friend... I was dreaming of you, I think.
Or of someone like you...
friendly.zh:
啊，朋友……我好像梦见你了。
或者是和你很像的人……

friendly.en:
I know your footsteps now...
Did you see Father up there?
friendly.zh:
我已经认得你的脚步声了……
你在上面见到父亲了吗？

close.en:
There you are... I kept a warm spot for you.
Lean on me. I am soft enough...
close.zh:
你来了……我给你留了个暖和的地方。
靠着我吧。我够软的……

close.en:
I sleep better knowing you are climbing...
Is that strange?
close.zh:
知道你在攀登，我睡得更安稳了……
这很奇怪吗？

close.en:
My friend... you carry so many scars now.
Let me take some of the weight...
close.zh:
朋友……你身上的伤越来越多了。
让我替你分担一点吧……

devoted.en:
You... my dear one. I stayed awake for you.
Almost...
devoted.zh:
是你……亲爱的。我一直醒着等你。
差不多吧……

devoted.en:
When I melt away, I hope some of me stays with you...
That would be enough.
devoted.zh:
等我融化殆尽的那天，希望我还有一部分留在你身上……
那样就够了。

devoted.en:
Welcome home... yes, I think of this as your home now.
Take whatever you need...
devoted.zh:
欢迎回家……是的，我把这里当成你的家了。
需要什么就拿吧……

reply.en:
A little... like a long sigh that never ends.
But you asked. That helps more than you know...
reply.zh:
有一点……像一声没有尽头的叹息。
但你问了。这比你想的更有用……

choice.en: I will look in on your father.
choice.zh: 我会替你去看看你父亲。

reply.en:
Thank you... Tell him I am well. Mostly.
And be gentle with him, if you can...
reply.zh:
谢谢你……告诉他我很好。大体上还好。
如果可以的话，对他温柔些……

reply.en:
Mm... that is kind. Nobody says that to me...
zZZzz... oh, you are still here. Sorry...
reply.zh:
嗯……真好。没人对我说过这个……
zZZzz……哦，你还在啊。抱歉……

choice.en: You are kinder than this whole Spire.

reply.en:
The Spire is only tired, like me...
But I will keep your words. They are warm...
reply.zh:
高塔只是累了，和我一样……
不过你的话我收下了。它们很暖……

reply.en:
Climbers passing by... Father, far above...
Sometimes nothing at all. Those are the best...
reply.zh:
路过的攀登者……在高处的父亲……
有时候什么也梦不到。那是最好的梦……

choice.en: Can I rest here a moment?

reply.en:
Of course... as long as you like.
I will snore, though. Forgive me in advance...
reply.zh:
当然……想歇多久都行。
不过我会打鼾。先跟你说声抱歉……

choice.zh: 你为什么叫建筑师父亲？

reply.en:
Because he is... We cannot pick who made us.
We only pick how we feel about it...
reply.zh:
因为他就是……谁造了我们，我们选不了。
我们只能选择怎么看待这件事……

choice.en: How long have you been here?

reply.en:
Long enough to forget... I count in naps, not days.
Many, many naps...
reply.zh:
久到我都忘了……我不按天数算，按睡了几觉来算。
很多很多觉……

choice.en: Will you run out of flesh?

reply.en:
Not yet... sleep brings it back.
One day, perhaps. But not today...
reply.zh:
还不会……睡一觉就长回来了。
也许总有一天吧。但不是今天……

reply.en:
Harder things... and Father at the top.
Climb slowly. Anger makes the stairs steeper...
reply.zh:
更难对付的东西……父亲在最顶上。
慢慢爬吧。愤怒会让台阶变得更陡……

choice.en: Is it safe to sleep here?

reply.en:
Nothing bothers me much... I am too big, and too soft.
Sleep, if you like. I will be here...
reply.zh:
没什么会来打扰我……我太大，又太软了。
想睡就睡吧。我会在这里……

choice.en: You are just a lazy lump.

reply.en:
Lazy... yes, maybe. Tired, more truly.
You sound tired too. Take some of me anyway...
reply.zh:
懒……嗯，也许吧。更准确地说是累。
你听起来也很累。还是拿一点我的肉吧……

reply.en:
Maybe you have reasons... I am sorry for them.
But killing him will not give you what you want...
reply.zh:
也许你有你的理由……我为那些事难过。
可杀了他，你也得不到想要的东西……

reply.en:
Mm... I am awake. Mostly.
You do not have to be so loud. I am listening...
reply.zh:
嗯……我醒着呢。差不多吧。
你不用这么大声。我在听……

choice.en: I only came to take from you.
choice.zh: 我来这就是为了拿东西。

reply.en:
That is alright... that is what I am here for.
I only wish you would stay a little...
reply.zh:
没关系……我本来就是为这个在这里的。
只是希望你能多待一会儿……

deal.en: Before you go... could you do something for me? Just a small thing...
deal.zh: 走之前……能帮我做件事吗？一件小事而已……

deal.en: I have a little request... if you are not too tired...
deal.zh: 我有个小小的请求……如果你还不太累的话……

deal.en: Would you... mm. I need your help with something. Listen...
deal.zh: 你能不能……嗯，我有件事想请你帮忙。听我说……

gift.en: Here... a piece of me. It will grow back...
gift.zh: 给……这是我的一部分。它会长回来的……

gift.en: Take this. I have more than I need...
gift.zh: 拿着吧。我有的比我需要的多……

gift.en: For your climb... do not thank me. Just rest when you can...
gift.zh: 带着它上路吧……不用谢我。能休息的时候就休息……

hostile.en:
Oh. It's you.
Didn't think ya'd have the nerve to come pokin' round my pile again.
hostile.zh:
哦，是你呀。
没想到你还好意思回来翻我这堆东西。

hostile.en:
Hmph! I remember what ya did, even if Neow made ya forget!
Well... look all ya want, but no grabbin', got it?
hostile.zh:
哼！就算涅奥让你忘了，我可还记着你干的事呢！
行吧……看可以，别乱拿，听见没？

hostile.en:
(Darv pulls a tarp over the pile.)
Nothin' to see here! Nothin' to take neither!
hostile.zh:
（达弗扯了块布把那堆东西盖上。）
这儿没啥好看的！也没啥好拿的！

stranger.en:
Oh! A new face! Or an old face that forgot me, ha!
Come, come, have a gander at my collection!
stranger.zh:
喔！新面孔！还是把我给忘了的老面孔？哈！
来来，看看我的收藏呗！

stranger.en:
...now where did that thing roll off to... Oh! Hello there!
Don't be shy, the pile don't bite! Mostly.
stranger.zh:
……那玩意儿滚哪儿去了……喔！你好呀！
别害羞嘛，这堆东西不咬人的！大部分不咬。

stranger.en:
Climbin' the Spire, huh? Everybody is these days!
Well, ya found the best stop on the way up!
stranger.zh:
在爬高塔呀？这年头谁不爬呀！
那你算是找对地方啦，这可是路上最好的一站！

friendly.en:
Hey hey, it's my favorite climber! Well, one of 'em!
I saved somethin' shiny just for ya!
friendly.zh:
嘿嘿，是我最喜欢的攀登者！呃，最喜欢的之一啦！
我给你留了个亮闪闪的东西！

friendly.en:
Still kickin'? Good good good!
Come sit, I got new stuff since last time... I think.
friendly.zh:
还活蹦乱跳的呀？好好好！
快坐，上回之后我又收了新东西……应该是吧。

friendly.en:
There ya are! I was just tellin' the pile about ya!
Nevermind that. Come look!
friendly.zh:
你来啦！我刚还跟这堆东西聊起你呢！
当我没说。快来看！

close.en:
Buddy! I knew ya'd make it back up here!
Pity ya don't remember all the other times, ha!
close.zh:
好伙计！我就知道你会再爬上来！
可惜你不记得之前那么多回了，哈！

close.en:
I kept a whole corner of the pile just for your stuff!
Don't tell the others. They'd get jealous!
close.zh:
我专门给你的东西留了一整个角落！
别告诉其他人哈，他们会吃醋的！

close.en:
Oh good, you're here! I was gettin' worried!
...Not that I worry! Hoarders don't worry! Nevermind nevermind!!
close.zh:
太好了，你来啦！我还有点担心呢！
……不是说我会担心啊！收藏家才不担心！当我没说，当我没说！！

devoted.en:
You! Every time Neow sends ya back, I remember for the both of us.
That's what the collection's for, ya know?
devoted.zh:
是你！每次涅奥把你送回来，我都替咱俩记着呢。
收藏不就是干这个用的嘛，你说是吧？

devoted.en:
Take anything. Take everything! Well, not the heavy stuff, ya gotta climb.
I just want ya to make it, buddy.
devoted.zh:
随便拿！全拿走都行！呃，太重的就算了，你还得爬呢。
我就是想让你爬上去，好伙计。

devoted.en:
My dearest customer! Er, not customer. Friend! Best friend!
Where did I put... Oh, right here. I always keep the best for you.
devoted.zh:
我最亲爱的客人！呃，不是客人，是朋友！最好的朋友！
我放哪儿了……喔，在这儿呢。最好的我一直给你留着。

reply.en:
Oh, where do I even start! That pile's all things folks forgot they ever had!
This one's... hm, no idea! That's the fun part!
reply.zh:
哎呀，从哪儿说起好呢！那边那堆全是别人都忘了自己有过的东西！
这个嘛……唔，我也不知道是啥！这才好玩呀！

choice.en: You seem happy to see me.
choice.zh: 你看起来很高兴见到我。

reply.en:
Happy? I'm thrilled! Nobody visits a hoarder for the company, ya know!
Except you. You're alright.
reply.zh:
高兴？我简直乐坏啦！谁会专门来找收藏家聊天呀！
除了你。你还不赖嘛。

reply.en:
Aw, stop it! Ya'll make an old hoarder blush!
Just put the stuff to good use, that's all the thanks I need.
reply.zh:
哎呀别说啦！再说我这老收藏家要脸红啦！
东西好好用上就行，这就是最好的谢礼啦。

reply.en:
Favorite? Ooh, how do I pick... this one! No, that one!
The one I can't find. It's always the one I can't find.
reply.zh:
最喜欢的？哎呀，这叫我怎么挑……这个！不对，那个！
是我找不着的那个。每次都是找不着的那个。

choice.en: I'll get back what the Architect took.
choice.zh: 建筑师抢走的东西，我帮你拿回来。

reply.en:
You'd do that?! For me?!
Oh, but don't go gettin' hurt over it. Shinies ain't worth that much... mostly.
reply.zh:
你愿意？！为了我？！
不过可别为这个把自己弄伤了哈。亮闪闪的东西没那么金贵……大部分吧。

reply.en:
Lonely? With all this stuff?! Nah!
...Well, stuff don't talk back much. That's why I like it when ya drop by.
reply.zh:
孤单？有这么多宝贝陪着？！才不会呢！
……好吧，东西又不会跟我聊天。所以你来我才高兴嘛。

choice.en: Where do you find all this?
choice.zh: 这些东西你都是从哪儿弄来的？

reply.en:
Here and there! Mostly there!
The scary ones especially, they just kinda show up. Don't ask me how!
reply.zh:
这儿弄点，那儿弄点！主要是那儿！
尤其是吓人的东西，自己就冒出来了。别问我是怎么回事！

choice.en: What do you know about the Architect?

reply.en:
Grabby! That's what I know! Nabbed somethin' of mine and never gave it back!
Other than that... eh, ya'd have to ask 'em yourself.
reply.zh:
手可长啦！我就知道这个！抢了我的东西就再也没还过！
别的嘛……唉，你还是自己去问吧。

reply.en:
Sure, sure! Everybody's just passin' through!
At least pass through with somethin' useful, eh?
reply.zh:
是啦是啦！谁不是路过呀！
那至少拿点有用的再走呗？

reply.en:
Course I do! Neow's the one who does the forgettin', not me!
I got a whole shelf of your stuff somewhere... where was it...
reply.zh:
当然记得！让人忘事的是涅奥，又不是我！
我在哪儿还有一整架跟你有关的东西呢……放哪儿了来着……

reply.en:
Ya look it, buddy! All banged up!
But ya kept kickin' this far. Let's see if the pile's got somethin' to help ya along.
reply.zh:
看得出来，好伙计！浑身都是伤！
不过你能一路撑到这儿。来看看这堆里有没有能帮上你的东西。

reply.en:
Junk?! Junk is just treasure nobody's loved yet!
Hmph. Well, I still like ya. Mostly.
reply.zh:
破烂？！破烂只是还没人疼的宝贝！
哼。算了，我还是挺喜欢你的。大概吧。

choice.en: Stop talking and give me something.

reply.en:
Ha! Straight to business, huh?
Fine, fine, but the talkin' comes free with the shinies. Can't have one without the other!
reply.zh:
哈！直接谈正事是吧？
行行行，不过唠叨是跟宝贝一起白送的，拆不开的！

choice.zh: 你就是个疯疯癫癫的老收藏狂。

reply.en:
Crazy? Maybe! Old? Definitely!
But this crazy old hoarder's got what ya need, so be nice!
reply.zh:
疯？也许吧！老？那肯定的！
不过这个疯老头手里有你要的东西，嘴上客气点呗！

reply.en:
...Oh.
Well, I care! Somebody forgot every one of these, so somebody's gotta remember 'em.
reply.zh:
……哦。
那我在乎呀！这些东西每一件都被人忘了，总得有人替它们记着吧。

deal.en: Say, since you're here... help a buddy out with somethin', will ya?
deal.zh: 哎，既然你来了……帮你这个好伙计一个小忙呗？

deal.en: Oh! Oh! I just remembered, I need a favor! Won't take long, promise!
deal.zh: 喔！喔！我刚想起来，有件事要你帮忙！不耽误你多久，保证！

deal.en: Tell ya what, do somethin' for me and I'll make it worth your while!
deal.zh: 这样吧，你帮我办件事，我保证不亏待你！

gift.en: Here, here, take this one! It's been waitin' for ya, I'm sure of it!
gift.zh: 来来，拿着这个！它肯定一直在等你，我敢打包票！

gift.en: Found it! ...Wait, no, that's... eh, it'll do! Put it to good use!
gift.zh: 找到了！……等等，不对，这个是……哎，也行！好好用上哦！

gift.en: Don't say I never gave ya nothin'! Well, ya won't remember anyway, ha!
gift.zh: 别说我从没给过你东西哈！反正你也记不住，哈！

hostile.en:
YOU AGAIN!! LAST TIME YOU RAN!!
NO RUNNING NOW! FIGHT ME!!
hostile.zh:
又是你！！上次你跑了！！
这次不许跑！与我一战！！

hostile.en:
HMPH!! YOU TOOK A WEAPON AND LEFT!!
YOU EARN A WEAPON IN A FIGHT!!
hostile.zh:
哼！！你拿了武器就走！！
武器要靠战斗来拿！！

hostile.en:
I AM NOT HAPPY WITH YOU!!
BUT FIGHT ME AND WE ARE EVEN!!
hostile.zh:
我对你很不满！！
但跟我打一场，就算扯平！！

stranger.en:
WHO ARE YOU!? SMALL! BUT NOT TOO SMALL!!
SHOW ME YOUR WEAPON!!
stranger.zh:
你是谁！？小！但不算太小！！
给我看看你的武器！！

stranger.en:
A CLIMBER!! GOOD!!
CLIMBERS ARE FOR FIGHTING!!
stranger.zh:
一个攀登者！！好！！
攀登者就是用来战斗的！！

stranger.en:
HALT!! I AM TANX!!
YOU LOOK LIKE YOU NEED MORE WEAPONS!!
stranger.zh:
站住！！我是坦克斯！！
你看着就缺武器！！

friendly.en:
YOU CAME BACK!! GOOD!!
YOU LOOK STRONGER! STILL NOT STRONG ENOUGH!!
friendly.zh:
你回来了！！好！！
你变强了！但还不够强！！

friendly.en:
I SAVED WEAPONS FOR YOU!!
SOME OF THEM. I KEEP THE BIG ONES!!
friendly.zh:
我给你留了武器！！
留了一些。大的我自己留着！！

friendly.en: HA!! THERE IS MY FAVORITE OPPONENT!!
friendly.zh: 哈！！我最喜欢的对手来了！！

close.en:
MY RIVAL!! YOU STILL STAND!! GOOD!!
ONLY I GET TO BEAT YOU!!
close.zh:
我的对手！！你还站着！！好！！
只有我能打败你！！

close.en:
I THINK ABOUT OUR NEXT FIGHT ALL DAY!!
ALSO WEAPONS. MOSTLY WEAPONS!!
close.zh:
我整天想着我们下一场战斗！！
还有武器。主要是武器！！

close.en:
YOU ARE GETTING MIGHTY!!
I AM PROUD! AND A LITTLE SCARED! NO! ONLY PROUD!!
close.zh:
你越来越强大了！！
我很骄傲！也有点怕！不！只有骄傲！！

devoted.en:
MY FRIEND!! MY BEST RIVAL!!
WHOEVER HURTS YOU FIGHTS ME TOO!!
devoted.zh:
我的朋友！！我最好的对手！！
谁敢伤你，就得先跟我打！！

devoted.en: YOU ARE HERE!! NOW THIS PLACE IS MIGHTY!!
devoted.zh: 你来了！！这地方都变强大了！！

devoted.en:
I POLISHED EVERY WEAPON FOR YOU!!
ALL OF THEM!! IT TOOK A LONG TIME!!
devoted.zh:
我把每把武器都给你擦亮了！！
全部！！花了好久！！

choice.zh: 你的武器真厉害，坦克斯。

reply.en:
OF COURSE!! EVERY ONE IS MIGHTY!!
YOU HAVE GOOD TASTE, CLIMBER!!
reply.zh:
当然！！每一把都很强大！！
你眼光不错！！

choice.en: I will fight you once I'm stronger.

reply.en:
YES!! YES!! A PROMISE!!
GROW FAST! I AM WAITING RIGHT HERE!!
reply.zh:
好！！好！！说定了！！
快点变强！我就在这儿等你！！

reply.en:
ALL OF THEM!! NO!! THE BIGGEST ONE!!
NO!! THE NEXT ONE I FIND!!
reply.zh:
全部！！不对！！最大的那把！！
不对！！是我下一把找到的！！

choice.en: You look strong today, big one.

reply.en:
I LOOK STRONG EVERY DAY!!
BUT THANK YOU!! YOU LOOK LESS WEAK!!
reply.zh:
我每天都很壮！！
不过谢谢你！！你看着没那么弱了！！

choice.en: Thanks for helping me on the climb.

reply.en:
HELP!? I AM ARMING MY FUTURE OPPONENT!!
THAT IS NOT HELP! THAT IS A PLAN!!
reply.zh:
帮你！？我是在武装未来的对手！！
这不叫帮！这叫计划！！

choice.en: Could you teach me to fight like you?
choice.zh: 能教我像你那样战斗吗？

reply.en:
EASY!! STEP ONE: HIT HARD!!
STEP TWO: HIT HARDER!! THERE IS NO STEP THREE!!
reply.zh:
简单！！第一步：用力打！！
第二步：更用力打！！没有第三步！！

choice.en: What do you think of the Architect?

reply.en:
THE ARCHITECT!? IS IT STRONG!?
THEN IT SHOULD FIGHT ME!! THAT IS ALL I THINK!!
reply.zh:
建筑师！？它强吗！？
那它就该跟我打！！我就想这么多！！

reply.en:
HURT!? THEN NO FIGHTING TODAY!!
REST! HEAL! THEN COME BACK AND HIT ME!!
reply.zh:
受伤了！？那今天不打！！
休息！养好！再回来揍我！！

choice.en: How far is the top of the Spire?

reply.en:
FAR!! MANY FIGHTS FAR!!
GOOD!! EVERY FIGHT MAKES YOU STRONGER!!
reply.zh:
很远！！还要打很多场！！
好事！！每打一场，你就更强！！

choice.en: Why do you collect so many weapons?
choice.zh: 你为什么收集这么多武器？

reply.en:
MORE WEAPONS MEANS MORE FIGHTS!!
MORE FIGHTS MEANS MORE FUN!! VERY SIMPLE!!
reply.zh:
武器多，打得就多！！
打得多，就开心！！就这么简单！！

reply.en:
TIRED!? KINGS DO NOT GET TIRED!!
SOMETIMES I NAP ON MY WEAPON PILE. THAT IS DIFFERENT!!
reply.zh:
累！？国王不会累！！
有时我在武器堆上打个盹。那不一样！！

choice.zh: 你就是个大嗓门的蠢货。

reply.en:
LOUD!? YES!! OAF!? HMM!!
BEAT ME, THEN SAY IT AGAIN!!
reply.zh:
大嗓门！？没错！！蠢货！？嗯！！
打赢我再说一遍！！

reply.en:
JUNK!!? THESE ARE WEAPONS!!
YOU HURT THEIR FEELINGS!! AND MINE!!
reply.zh:
破烂！！？这些是武器！！
你伤了它们的心！！还有我的！！

choice.en: Fighting you is a waste of time.

reply.en:
WASTE!!? FIGHTING IS THE BEST USE OF TIME!!
YOU ARE WRONG! I FORGIVE YOU! GROW UP!!
reply.zh:
浪费！！？战斗才是最值的事！！
你错了！我原谅你！长大点吧！！

deal.en: CLIMBER!! I HAVE A TASK FOR YOU!! A MIGHTY ONE!! LISTEN!!
deal.zh: 攀登者！！我有个任务给你！！很豪迈的任务！！听好！！

deal.en: WAIT!! I WANT SOMETHING FROM YOU!! HEAR ME!!
deal.zh: 等等！！我要你做件事！！听我说！！

deal.en: YOU WANT TO GROW STRONGER!? THEN DO THIS FOR ME!!
deal.zh: 想变强！？那就替我办件事！！

gift.en: HERE!! TAKE IT!! NO THANK YOU!! JUST GET STRONGER!!
gift.zh: 给！！拿着！！不用谢！！快点变强就行！！

gift.en: THIS IS FOR YOU!! USE IT ON SOMETHING BIG!!
gift.zh: 这个给你！！拿去对付大家伙！！

gift.en: TAKE THIS!! COME BACK MIGHTIER!! I WILL KNOW IF YOU DON'T!!
gift.zh: 收下！！回来时要更强大！！不然我会知道的！！

hostile.en:
Oh, it's you again. Tezcatara remembers, dear.
Come in anyway. Fire doesn't hold grudges. Mostly.
hostile.zh:
哎呀，又是你呀。特兹卡塔拉可都记着呢，亲爱的。
进来吧。火是不记仇的……大多数时候吧。

hostile.en:
Back after what you did? Brave little thing.
Sit down. Tezcatara hasn't decided what to burn yet.
hostile.zh:
做了那种事还敢回来？真是个勇敢的小家伙呢。
坐下吧。特兹卡塔拉还没想好要烧掉什么呢。

hostile.en:
Oh, sweetie. You hurt Tezcatara's feelings last time.
(Tezcatara smiles very wide) But I'll forgive you. Probably.
hostile.zh:
哎呀，小可爱。上次你可伤了特兹卡塔拉的心呢。
（特兹卡塔拉笑得嘴都咧开了）不过我会原谅你的。大概吧。

stranger.en:
Oh my, a new face! Come in, come in, dear!
Tezcatara just pulled something out of the fire.
stranger.zh:
啊呀呀，是张新面孔！快进来，进来吧，亲爱的！
特兹卡塔拉刚从火里拿出点好东西呢。

stranger.en:
Who's that at the door? Come closer, sweetie, my eyes aren't what they were.
There. Much better.
stranger.zh:
门口是谁呀？再过来一点，小可爱，我的眼神不太好使啦。
好啦，这下看清楚了。

stranger.en:
A visitor, climbing all this way! You must be starving.
Sit, sit. Tell Tezcatara what needs burning.
stranger.zh:
有客人一路爬到这里来啦！你一定饿坏了吧。
坐，快坐。告诉特兹卡塔拉，有什么需要烧掉的呀？

friendly.en: There you are, dear! I kept the oven warm for you.
friendly.zh: 你来啦，亲爱的！我一直给你把炉子热着呢。

friendly.en:
Welcome back, sweetie! Still climbing? Good, good.
The Architect won't kill himself, will he?
friendly.zh:
欢迎回来，小可爱！还在往上爬吗？很好，很好。
建筑师总不会自己去死的，对吧？

friendly.en:
Oh, I know those footsteps! Come in, come in.
Let's see what flaws you've picked up since last time.
friendly.zh:
哎呀，这脚步声我认得！进来，进来吧。
让我瞧瞧你这次又沾上了哪些缺点。

close.en: My favourite visitor! Tezcatara baked extra, just for you.
close.zh: 我最喜欢的客人来啦！特兹卡塔拉特意给你多烤了一些哦。

close.en:
Come here, dear, let me look at you.
Thinner again. Those stairs are working you to the bone.
close.zh:
过来，亲爱的，让我好好看看你。
又瘦了。那些台阶真是要把你累垮了呀。

close.en:
Ah, back again! I was just thinking of you.
And of the Architect, burning. Nice thoughts, both.
close.zh:
啊，你又回来啦！我刚才还在想你呢。
还想着建筑师烧起来的样子。两个都是好念头呀。

devoted.en:
Sweetie! Oh, Tezcatara could just eat you up.
Come sit by the fire, you're family now.
devoted.zh:
小可爱！哎呀，特兹卡塔拉真想把你一口吃掉呢。
来火边坐吧，你现在可是一家人啦。

devoted.en:
There's my darling. I'd burn anything for you, you know.
The Architect first, of course.
devoted.zh:
我的心肝来啦。为了你，我什么都肯烧哦。
当然啦，得先烧建筑师。

devoted.en:
You came back to me! I always know you will.
Now eat. You'll need your strength to kill him.
devoted.zh:
你又回到我身边啦！我就知道你会回来的。
来，吃吧。要杀他可得有力气才行呀。

reply.en:
Doesn't it? Fresh from the fire, sweetie.
Don't ask what's inside. Just eat.
reply.zh:
是吧？刚从火里拿出来的哦，小可爱。
别问里头是什么，吃就是了。

reply.en:
My kitchen, dear. My home.
Nothing to worry about in here. Have a bite.
reply.zh:
是我的厨房呀，亲爱的。也是我的家。
在这儿没什么好担心的。来，吃一口。

choice.en: I didn't come here for snacks.

reply.en:
No? Then you'll leave with some anyway.
Nobody refuses Tezcatara's cooking, dear. Nobody.
reply.zh:
不是吗？那你走的时候也得带上一些。
没有人能拒绝特兹卡塔拉的手艺，亲爱的。没有人。

choice.en: Thank you for looking after me.

reply.en:
Oh, listen to you! Such a sweet thing.
Someone has to. The Spire certainly won't.
reply.zh:
哎呀，听听这话！真是个贴心的孩子。
总得有人照顾你呀。尖塔可不会。

choice.en: Why do you want the Architect dead?
choice.zh: 你为什么想让建筑师死？

reply.en:
Oh, does there need to be a reason, sweetie?
Some things are simply better burnt. Now, more treats?
reply.zh:
哎呀，这还需要理由吗，小可爱？
有些东西烧掉了就是更好嘛。再来点点心？

choice.zh: 你的火让我觉得很暖和。

reply.en:
That's what it's for, dear! Warming and burning.
Mostly the same thing, if you think about it.
reply.zh:
火就是干这个的呀，亲爱的！暖身子，还有烧东西。
仔细想想，其实也差不多嘛。

choice.en: You're just a big lump of fire.

reply.en:
Hee hee! Such a mouth on you!
Careful, sweetie. Lumps of fire get hungry too.
reply.zh:
嘻嘻！这张小嘴可真厉害！
小心点哦，小可爱。一坨火也是会饿的。

choice.en: What happens when you burn a flaw?

reply.en:
It goes away, dear. Pop! Like it was never there.
And most of the time, the rest of you stays.
reply.zh:
它就没了呀，亲爱的。噗！就像从来没有过一样。
大多数时候，你剩下的部分都还在呢。

choice.zh: 你最近过得好吗，特兹卡塔拉？

reply.en:
Oh, how kind to ask! Nobody asks.
Waiting, mostly. Waiting for someone to kill him. Could be you!
reply.zh:
哎呀，你真体贴！都没人问过我呢。
一直在等呀。等有人去把他杀了。说不定就是你哦！

reply.en:
Oh, you're adorable when you're cross!
Fine, fine. Sweetie it stays, sweetie.
reply.zh:
哎呀，你生气的样子真可爱！
好啦好啦。还是叫你小可爱吧，小可爱。

reply.en:
Of course it is, sweetie. He made it that way.
That's why you eat before you go. Open wide.
reply.zh:
那当然啦，小可爱。他就是故意弄成这样的。
所以出门前得先吃饱呀。来，张嘴。

choice.en: I'll bring you the Architect's head.
choice.zh: 我会把建筑师的脑袋带给你。

reply.en:
Would you? Oh, what a darling!
Bring it warm, dear. Tezcatara hates cold leftovers.
reply.zh:
真的吗？哎呀，真是个好孩子！
趁热带来哦，亲爱的。特兹卡塔拉最讨厌放凉的剩菜了。

choice.en: Can you really not see well?

reply.en:
Only shapes and warmth, dear. You're a very warm shape.
Tezcatara sees what matters.
reply.zh:
只能看到轮廓和热气啦，亲爱的。你就是个暖乎乎的轮廓呢。
该看清的东西，特兹卡塔拉都看得见。

choice.en: I don't trust you or your food.
choice.zh: 我不相信你，也不相信你的吃的。

reply.en:
Smart. The Spire teaches that, doesn't it?
But Tezcatara wants him dead as much as you do. More, even.
reply.zh:
真聪明。是尖塔教会你的吧？
可特兹卡塔拉跟你一样想让他死呢。说不定比你还想。

choice.en: You're the kindest one in this tower.
choice.zh: 你是这座塔里最和善的了。

reply.en:
Kind? Hee hee! Tezcatara's been called many things.
Keep saying it, sweetie. It keeps the fire happy.
reply.zh:
和善？嘻嘻！特兹卡塔拉被人叫过好多名字呢。
多说几遍吧，小可爱。火听了会开心的。

deal.en: Oh, sweetie, would you do Tezcatara a tiny favour?
deal.zh: 哎呀，小可爱，能帮特兹卡塔拉一个小忙吗？

deal.en: Before you go, dear, I have a little something to ask.
deal.zh: 走之前呀，亲爱的，我有件小事想拜托你。

deal.en: Now, one small thing. Nothing a strong one like you can't manage.
deal.zh: 嗯，就一件小事。对你这么厉害的孩子来说，肯定不难啦。

gift.en: Here, take this, dear. Don't tell the others.
gift.zh: 来，拿着吧，亲爱的。可别告诉别人哦。

gift.en: Still warm from the fire! Go on, it's for you.
gift.zh: 还带着火的热乎气呢！拿着吧，是给你的。

gift.en: Tezcatara saved this just for you, sweetie. Now go kill him.
gift.zh: 这是特兹卡塔拉专门给你留的哦，小可爱。好啦，去杀了他吧。

hostile.en: You again. You broke our last arrangement, and still you come to my door...?
hostile.zh: 又是你。上次的约定被你毁了，你居然还敢来找我……？

hostile.en:
I remember every clause you failed to honor.
Shall we discuss the interest?
hostile.zh:
你没履行的每一条款，我都记得。
要不要谈谈利息呢？

hostile.en:
(Vakuu does not rise.)
A debtor who walks in unafraid. How refreshing...
hostile.zh:
（瓦库没有起身。）
欠债的人居然毫不畏惧地走进来。真是新鲜呵……

stranger.en: A new face within these accursed walls? Sit. Everyone who reaches me has already lost something.
stranger.zh: 这被诅咒的墙内又来了新面孔？坐吧。能走到我面前的人，都已经失去过什么了。

stranger.en:
You look like someone who wants more than the Spire will give.
I can arrange that... for a price.
stranger.zh:
你看上去想要的比尖塔肯给的更多。
这我可以安排……当然，要有代价。

stranger.en:
Hesitating at the threshold, are we?
Hesitation costs nothing. That is precisely why it earns nothing.
stranger.zh:
在门口犹豫是么？
犹豫不花任何代价，所以也换不来任何东西。

friendly.en: Back again. You are becoming one of my more reliable visitors...
friendly.zh: 又回来了。你快成了我最可靠的访客之一了呢……

friendly.en: Ah, my favorite signatory. Your ink dried so neatly last time.
friendly.zh: 啊，我最中意的签约人。上次你的墨迹干得很整齐哦。

friendly.en:
You survived. Good.
Dead climbers make terrible customers.
friendly.zh:
你活下来了。很好。
死掉的攀登者可是最糟糕的顾客。

close.en: I count your visits, you know. I don't do that for many.
close.zh: 你知道么，我一直在数你来过几次。能让我这么做的人可不多。

close.en: Sit closer. Between us, the fine print can wait a moment...
close.zh: 坐近些。你我之间，那些小字条款可以晚点再说……

close.en:
You keep returning to a demon.
What does that say about the rest of the Spire?
close.zh:
你一次又一次回到恶魔这里。
这说明尖塔里其他的东西有多糟呢？

devoted.en:
Of all who climb, you are the one I would least like to lose.
Consider that a clause in your favor.
devoted.zh:
在所有攀登者之中，你是我最不想失去的那一个。
就当这是一条对你有利的条款吧。

devoted.en:
Come. For you, the price is always a little smaller...
Never nothing. But smaller.
devoted.zh:
过来吧。对你，代价总是会少一些……
不会没有，但会少一些。

devoted.en:
When the Architect falls, I want you standing there.
Not as my puppet. As my partner.
devoted.zh:
等建筑师倒下的时候，我希望站在那里的是你。
不是作为我的傀儡，而是作为我的伙伴。

choice.en: I came back just to see you.

reply.en:
To see me. How touching.
Those who come to see me usually leave owing something... shall we find out what you'll owe?
reply.zh:
特意来看我？真令人感动。
来看我的人，走时通常都欠了些什么……你猜你会欠我什么？

choice.en: You seem wounded. Are you alright?
choice.zh: 你好像受伤了。你还好么？

reply.en:
The Architect's work. It does not close.
How kind of you to ask. Kindness is a currency here too, you know...
reply.zh:
建筑师留下的伤，一直没有愈合。
谢谢你关心。在这里，关心也是一种货币哦……

reply.en:
Every word exactly where it belongs. So few people notice.
Fewer still read to the end...
reply.zh:
每一个字都放在它该在的地方。很少有人注意到。
能读到最后的就更少了……

choice.en: Tell me what you truly want.
choice.zh: 告诉我你真正想要什么。

reply.en:
The Architect, gone. Simple.
I would rather not do it myself, of course. Isn't that what climbers are for?
reply.zh:
建筑师消失。就这么简单。
当然，我不想亲自动手。攀登者不就是为此存在的么？

reply.en:
You shouldn't trust anyone in the Spire.
But I have never lied to you. I simply haven't told you everything... is that not trust enough?
reply.zh:
在尖塔里，你不该信任任何人。
但我从没对你说过谎。我只是没把一切都告诉你……这样还不够么？

reply.en:
Don't thank me. Only those who haven't read the terms say thank you.
You'll pay in due time, and we will both be satisfied.
reply.zh:
不必谢我。只有没读过条款的人才会道谢。
该付的时候你自然会付，到时我们都会满意的。

choice.en: How long have you been here?

reply.en:
Longer than these walls you climb. Longer than your name.
You do understand it all comes around again, yes?
reply.zh:
比你爬的这些墙还久，比你的名字还久。
你明白这一切都会一再重来，对吧？

reply.en:
More of the same, and then the Architect.
Whether you reach him depends on what you are willing to sign.
reply.zh:
更多同样的东西，然后是建筑师。
你能不能见到他，取决于你愿意签下什么。

choice.zh: 别的攀登者也来找你么？

reply.en:
All of them, eventually. Some twice. Some many more times than that.
You are not special. Not yet.
reply.zh:
迟早都会来。有的来两次，有的来得更多。
你并不特别。至少现在还不是。

reply.en:
Nothing at all. You leave exactly as weak as you came.
That is the price of refusing... I find it rather steep.
reply.zh:
什么都不会发生。你怎么来的，就怎么虚弱地离开。
这就是拒绝的代价……我倒觉得挺高的。

reply.en:
Rest, then. It costs nothing.
The only free thing in my presence. Enjoy it while I feel generous.
reply.zh:
那就歇吧，这不花钱。
在我面前，这是唯一免费的东西。趁我还大方，好好享受吧。

choice.zh: 收起你那些该死的交易，恶魔。

reply.en:
Cursed? They are perfectly honest. Everything you paid for, you received.
You'll be back. They always come back...
reply.zh:
该死？它们再诚实不过了。你付出的，你都得到了。
你会回来的。大家总会回来……

reply.en:
A swindler lies. I never have.
If you signed without reading, whose fault is that?
reply.zh:
骗子才会说谎，我从来没有。
你签字前没好好读，那又是谁的错呢？

choice.en: One day I'll come for you too.
choice.zh: 总有一天我也会来收拾你。

reply.en:
Many have promised me that. I keep a list.
I'll add your name. It does get so long...
reply.zh:
许多人都这样许诺过，我都记着呢。
再添上你的名字吧……反正名单也不差这一个。

reply.en:
Go, then. The door is where you left it.
Once you've lost enough, you'll find me interesting again.
reply.zh:
走吧，门还在原处。
等你失去得够多了，自然会觉得我有趣起来的。

deal.en: Before you go, there is a small matter I'd like you to attend to... nothing you can't afford.
deal.zh: 走之前，有件小事想请你办……不会是你付不起的。

deal.en: I have a proposition. Read it carefully this time, won't you?
deal.zh: 我有一份提案。这次好好读完，好么？

deal.en: Let us draw up something small between us. A test of good faith, shall we say?
deal.zh: 我们之间来立一份小小的约定吧。就当是检验诚意，如何？

gift.en: Take it. No signature required... this time.
gift.zh: 拿去吧。不用签字……这一次不用。

gift.en: A gift. Don't look so suspicious, I will simply remember it.
gift.zh: 送你的。别那么多疑，我只是会记着这件事而已。

gift.en: Consider this an advance on our future arrangements...
gift.zh: 就当是我们日后交易的预付款吧……

hostile.en:
You again.
Pay first. Then we talk.
hostile.zh:
又是你。
先付钱，再说话。

hostile.en:
I remember your face.
I don't give credit. Least of all to you.
hostile.zh:
我记得你这张脸。
我这儿不赊账，对你更不赊。

hostile.en:
Browse if you must.
Keep your hands where I can see them.
hostile.zh:
要看就看。
手放在我看得见的地方。

stranger.en:
Hello.
Your gold goes further here.
stranger.zh:
你好。
金币就在这儿花。

stranger.en:
A new face.
The shop is open.
stranger.zh:
生面孔。
小店照常营业。

stranger.en:
Welcome.
Looking is free. Buying is not.
stranger.zh:
欢迎。
看是免费的。买可不是。

friendly.en:
Ah. A returning customer.
My favorite kind.
friendly.zh:
哦，老主顾。
我最喜欢这种客人。

friendly.en:
You're still climbing.
Good for business.
friendly.zh:
你还在往上爬。
这对生意有好处。

friendly.en:
(Taps the rug.)
Fresh stock. Take a look.
friendly.zh:
（拍了拍地毯）
新货到了，看看吧。

close.en:
There you are.
I set a few things aside. Not for free, of course.
close.zh:
你来了。
我给你留了几样东西。当然不是白送的。

close.en:
My best customer.
I don't say that to everyone.
close.zh:
我最好的主顾。
这话我不是对谁都说。

close.en:
You look worse than last time.
Sit. Browse. Spend.
close.zh:
你看起来比上次更糟。
坐下，慢慢看，慢慢花。

devoted.en:
I kept the rug out a little longer today.
In case you came.
devoted.zh:
今天我多摆了一会儿摊。
就等你来。

devoted.en:
You're alive. Good.
Dead customers don't come back.
devoted.zh:
你还活着。很好。
死人可不会回头光顾。

devoted.en:
Welcome back, friend.
Still no credit. But I'm glad you're here.
devoted.zh:
欢迎回来，朋友。
还是不赊账。不过你来了，我很高兴。

reply.en:
It always does.
Thank you for noticing. Now buy something.
reply.zh:
一直都不错。
谢谢你注意到了。现在买点什么吧。

choice.en: Don't you get tired of the climb?

reply.en:
I don't climb.
The rug is simply where it needs to be.
reply.zh:
我不爬。
地毯该在哪儿，就在哪儿。

choice.en: I brought you something that smells awful.

reply.en:
Yesss. You know what I like.
Don't stop there.
reply.zh:
好哎，你懂我。
有多少来多少。

reply.en:
Someone has to be.
Gold needs somewhere to go.
reply.zh:
总得有人在。
金币总得有个去处。

reply.en:
Business is steady.
That is all a merchant needs.
reply.zh:
生意还算稳。
做买卖的，要的也就这些。

choice.en: You're the only friendly face up here.

reply.en:
I'm polite. There's a difference.
But I'll take the compliment.
reply.zh:
我只是有礼貌。这不一样。
不过这句夸奖我收下了。

choice.en: What do you know about the Architect?

reply.en:
Enough.
The Architect isn't a customer. So I don't discuss the Architect.
reply.zh:
知道一些。
建筑师不来我这儿买东西，所以我不谈。

choice.en: Where do you get your stock?

reply.en:
Trade secret.
The price covers the mystery.
reply.zh:
商业机密。
价钱里包含了这份神秘。

choice.en: How much further to the top?

reply.en:
Further than your purse, by the look of it.
Keep climbing. Keep spending.
reply.zh:
看样子比你的钱包能撑的还远。
继续爬，继续花。

reply.en:
Everyone up here has.
Neow doesn't buy anything either.
reply.zh:
这上面谁没见过。
涅奥也不买东西。

reply.en:
I noticed.
I sell remedies. I don't sell sympathy.
reply.zh:
看出来了。
我卖药，不卖同情。

reply.en:
Robbers don't ask. I do.
Buy or don't.
reply.zh:
抢钱不用你点头。
买不买随你。

reply.en:
My face isn't for sale.
Neither is my patience.
reply.zh:
我的脸不卖。
我的耐心也不卖。

reply.en:
Then die with full pockets.
That's your business, not mine.
reply.zh:
那你就揣着一口袋钱去死吧。
那是你的事，不是我的。

choice.en: Shut up and give me a discount.

reply.en:
Discounts aren't given on demand.
I don't do favors for rudeness.
reply.zh:
开口要的折扣，我不打。
我这儿也不做善事。

deal.en: I have a small request. Good business for both of us.
deal.zh: 我有个小请求。对我们俩都是好买卖。

deal.en: A proposition. Hear me out before you reach for your purse.
deal.zh: 有桩生意。掏钱包之前先听我说完。

deal.en: You look capable. I could use that.
deal.zh: 你看着挺能干。我正好用得上。

gift.en: Take this. Don't tell the other customers.
gift.zh: 拿着。别告诉其他客人。

gift.en: On the house. Just this once.
gift.zh: 这次算我的。仅此一次。

gift.en: For a good customer. Consider it an investment.
gift.zh: 给好主顾的。就当是我投资。
